label: Кем сделано
description: A 10-sentence card for the passive agent expressed in the instrumental case.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. This is passive voice with the short participle написан. The agent известным автором stands in the instrumental, naming who wrote the novel.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental agent. Построен is the short passive participle, the house was built. The doers рабочими sit in the instrumental as the agents of the building.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. Принят is the short participle of the perfective passive, was passed. The agent парламентом appears in the instrumental as the body that adopted the law.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. Нарисована is the feminine short participle, was painted. The agent художником stands in the instrumental, telling us who created the picture.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent with быть. Было прочитано is the periphrastic passive, was read. The agent другом sits in the instrumental as the reader behind the action.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. Исполнена is the short passive participle, was performed. The agent певицей appears in the instrumental, naming who sang the song.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental agent. Принято is the neuter short participle, was made. The agent членами совета stands in the instrumental as those who took the decision.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. Спроектирован is the short passive participle, was designed. The agent инженером sits in the instrumental, marking who drew up the bridge.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental agent. Подписан is the short participle, was signed. The agents директорами stand in the instrumental as the ones who signed the contract.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. Переведена is the feminine short participle, was translated. The agent переводчиком appears in the instrumental, naming who rendered the article.
